items.q: How do I avoid looking like I am reading and maintain eye contact?
items.a: Activate SolPrompter's Notch Mode to position your script directly below the lens. A narrower reading column reduces visible side-to-side scanning, but the result still depends on your screen size, camera position, and reading distance.

items.q: Why choose SolPrompter over an App Store application?
items.a: SolPrompter works directly on the web, requires no download, and does not put watermarks on your video exports. It is a practical option when you want to paste a script and start without installing or creating an account.

items.q: Will the remote disconnect when my phone locks or goes to sleep?
items.a: SolPrompter's remote uses a persistent WebSocket session with a heartbeat to detect connection loss. Actual latency and behavior while a phone is locked depend on the devices, browser power-saving rules, and network quality.

items.q: Can I use SolPrompter with a physical glass beamsplitter rig?
items.a: Yes, toggle "Mirror Mode" in SolPrompter's settings to flip the text horizontally. To maximize reading contrast, switch the interface to dark mode (white text on a pure black background) to eliminate double reflections.

items.q: Are my scripts and corporate drafts secure?
items.a: Your scripts and recordings remain on your device while you work. SolPrompter does not upload that content to its servers. Voice recognition may still use an on-device engine or a recognition service supplied by your browser.

items.q: Why does the reflected text on my glass look blurry?
items.a: Double-reflections (ghosting) happen on normal glass. Use professional beamsplitter glass and lower screen brightness. A professional 70/30 glass has an anti-reflective coating on one side. Draping the back of the glass with a dark cloth is also necessary to prevent light leaks.

items.q: Can I run the teleprompter offline?
items.a: The teleprompter workspace can continue after the page has loaded, but voice sync availability depends on your browser's recognition mode. Use fixed-speed or manual scrolling when an offline speech-recognition engine is unavailable.

items.q: How do I determine the right font size for my reading distance?
items.a: Increase the font size as your reading distance grows, then test it at the exact camera position before recording. For close laptop reading, use a narrower text column to reduce visible side-to-side scanning.
